goal: Audit proposed shadow architectures for administrative bloat, eliminate duplicate choke points, and preserve single authoritative enforcement points.
hypothesis: Streamlining decision authorities from multi-tier redundant checks to single authoritative choke points reduces state-space complexity by >30% while preserving all safety invariants.
why_now: Addresses Section 158-165 requirements; prevents safety system from becoming unusable bureaucracy.
production_relation: Audits entire supervisor/ plane and chief/ control plane.
scope: Choke point authority deduplication, record minimization, simplicity ratio analysis
acceptance_criteria: Identified single authoritative choke points for dispatch, resources, and spend; removed redundant intermediate checks.
falsification_criteria: Simplification compromises any of the 4 core invariants (A01, L01, G01, B01).
